# M/S Mahamaya Motors

> Tata Motors Authorised Service Station in Janjgir-Champa

Expert 24x7 commercial vehicle care on NH-200. We are Janjgir-Champa's #1 Tata Authorised Service Station featuring the district's first computerised 3D wheel alignment. 

## About Us
We specialize in keeping commercial vehicle fleets moving. With precision diagnostic tools and Tata genuine expertise, our state-of-the-art facility is equipped to handle everything from routine maintenance to complex engine repairs.

## Core Services
- Computerised 3D Wheel Alignment
- Advanced Engine Diagnostics
- 24x7 Highway Emergency Support
- Tata Genuine Spare Parts
- Denting and Painting Work
- Fleet Maintenance
